text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-YRK01009ACBAL, 9 Inch Modern Acrylic Shower Door Handles

The 9 Inch Modern Acrylic Shower Door Handle Set has a 6 inch center to center. It comes packaged with everything you'll need to mount it back-to-back on a glass shower door. This acrylic pull is made from high quality clear acrylic; and the mounting brackets are brushed aluminum. This is one of our our most popular shower door pulls by far, it's modern, it's easy to care for, and it looks fantastic.

Also Available: 12" Modern Rectangular Shower Door Handles or 18 Modern Rectangular Shower Door Handles

Specifications for the First Impressions 9 Inch Modern Shower Door Pull Pair:

  • Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Bracket Material: Aluminum
  • Bracket Finish: Brushed Aluminum
  • Total Length: 9"
  • Center to Center Mount: 6"
  • Width: 1"
  • Thickness: 5/8"
  • Clearance: 1-11/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Rosette Projection 1/4"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

Note: This door pull is hand assembled in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pulls, 4 decorative rosettes plus mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.
